scope: Minimum requirements for one normal original-strategy -> external-battle -> original-strategy interface; not an exhaustive native engine state inventory

minimum_groups.name: scenario_and_participation
minimum_groups.current: STRUCTURAL_REFS_OBSERVED; stable names and definitions unresolved
minimum_groups.need: Keep source table order, HelpMap, attack/defense Power, Side/Troop membership separately; resolve portable IDs without equating raw pointers across PIDs
minimum_groups.known_ranges: E+1EED44/48 side pair, E+1EED4C/50 defense/attack Power; Side+14 Power, +18 separate flag, +1C peer

minimum_groups.name: unit_state
minimum_groups.current: Only Unit+1C8 and +1D0 links captured for all4190 unit-observations
minimum_groups.need: Values of HP/MP, effective statistics/status, position, facing, skill state, command/target state, ownership and lifetime; do not substitute DAT defaults
minimum_groups.candidate_ranges: Unit+90/94; +98..E4; +214..230; +178..184; +1C8..1D8; larger high-offset state as separately proved

minimum_groups.name: runtime_map
minimum_groups.current: NO captured G+1EF570 map manager header or E+1EECC4 request object
minimum_groups.need: Determine chosen map-file path/hash or non-file construction branch, dimensions, cells, objects, occupancy/dynamic changes and placement; filename/hash alone is insufficient

minimum_groups.name: time_and_limits
minimum_groups.current: Only GameTask-pass counter sampled; actual battle counters and native limit pair absent
minimum_groups.need: Keep Task-pass, battle elapsed, absolute scheduler count, limit initial tag and current value distinct

minimum_groups.name: rng_continuation
minimum_groups.current: CRT arithmetic statically known; actual state and owner context not captured
minimum_groups.need: Exact game-thread/fiber context plus current32-bit holdrand, any reseed or additional stream; do not call rand or __getptd just to observe
minimum_groups.native_chain: 0x5B6EAB -> 0x5BC6A9 -> 0x5BC630; PTD+14, FLS-index global0x65A9A4. Getter may allocate0x214 bytes and initialize owner state

minimum_groups.name: event_vm_and_native_tasks
minimum_groups.current: Task slot references observed but semantic state incomplete; VM four stack headers absent
minimum_groups.need: Preserve original frame-stack order/PC, pending bodies, event roots and callback ordering; retained in old process is an option only with validated no-double-tick/resume contract
minimum_groups.known_ranges: E+1EED78/88/98/A8 each vector header12bytes; E+1EEDB4/C0 and further pending lists; native Task eligibility fields depend on type

minimum_groups.name: coherent_handoff_and_return
minimum_groups.current: All8 snapshots span19..101 Task passes; earliest captures begin at63/73, not at setup return
minimum_groups.need: Prove original input boundary, stable object generation, coherent same-point state, one-time native result commit and rollback; ordinary polling is not proof
minimum_groups.static_candidates_only: 0x4B99CD CALL/return0x4B99D2; native init/ScriptBattle/task timing must be verified before any hook

capture_design.phase_a: copy bounded essential values and references with provenance before expensive Task classification
capture_design.phase_b: separate optional task/type introspection; a budget failure must not invalidate already-saved essential bytes
capture_design.phase_c: verify internal joins, temporal bounds and outstanding native callbacks offline; partial output stays partial
capture_design.native_state_ownership: Do not assume the full native VM or operating-system object memory must be serialized to another EXE. Keeping it in the original process requires an independently proven pause/command/resume contract.

forbidden_inferences: pointer present means object data present
Side+18 and HelpMap side_byte share one enum
snapshot after battle start is exact pre-first-tick state
known map file format identifies the map used
known PRNG formula proves captured live PRNG state
